verdicts.reason: A keeps the original reading order (eyebrow → headline → body → product → CTA) on one clean left edge, and the CTA lines up with the text. Its flaws are that the oversized bottle and circle sit off-centre to the right and compete with the headline, leaving the lower left looking a bit empty. B moves 'WEEKEND ONLY' below the body copy, so the eyebrow now reads as an afterthought, and the headline straddles the circle's edge. B also mixes a left-aligned text block with a centred bottle and CTA, leaves an orphaned 'sparkling.' and leaves dead space at the top left.
